notes: PAPER / BACKTEST only. Not a recommendation to bet.

Card primary % is the blended model p* = (1−λ)·p_cal + λ·p_novig (logit-space analogue where that won on tune). Raw calibrated % is the small secondary text. No blend is shown when there is no listed price.
PLAY/PASS uses own_frozen_v2: 4-pt blended edge, −250 to +250, $20 flat, max 5 PLAY per CT day GLOBAL, one side per game. Stop-loss/pause need realized results and are not applied to unplayed games.

λ was fit on the tune window only (minimize log loss). Holdout was graded once. NBA λ=0.96 is nearly the market, so NBA edges essentially vanish. CBB λ=0.96 (max of the others) is UNVALIDATED — no historical moneylines.
If λ→1 the blend equals the market and edges vanish. That is reported honestly, not avoided.
Official v2 holdout paper (blend + global 5/day): 9-31, −$403.71, ROI −50.46%, max DD −$383.71. Published v1 (unblended, per-sport 5/day) was 145-182, −$107.65. Both are on the Backtest tab.
Listed ESPN/DraftKings prices are not guaranteed Bovada closes.
Unmatched teams (non-D1 or not in the historical pool) are left off, not invented.
This is a separate desk. It is not desk-v1 and does not set CLEARs.
